Scottsdale Sprinters is a locally owned luxury transportation company serving Scottsdale, Phoenix and all of Arizona with executive Sprinters, party buses and group coaches driven by professional chauffeurs.

Occasions: Weddings, bachelorettes, birthdays, golf days, nights in Old Town

Every occasion gets its own package and its own extras, built by people who have driven a few hundred of them. We know when the bride needs the shuttle back, and when the bachelor party does not. Rated 5.0 from 544 Google reviews as of September 29, 2026, and 4.9 stars on Yelp.

Destinations: Sedona at sunrise, the Grand Canyon, the lakes

Day trips we have driven a hundred times and still love. The chauffeur knows the overlooks, the lunch stops and the way home, so the day is yours from the first mile.

The fleet: From a luxury SUV to a 56-passenger motorcoach

Sprinters, limos, party buses and coaches, detailed between every trip. Pick the one that seats your group and holds the mood you are going for; the rate is published and the deposit holds it. Best for groups who want to check before they book: a published rate on every vehicle, 6- to 56-seat vehicles, same-day bookings, and airport transfers flat within 15 road miles from pickup to drop-off, with longer ones priced from the drive and the empty return included.

The standard

Background and MVR checked. Every chauffeur, no exceptions. Drug screened. Every chauffeur on the roster. Trained, experienced, attentive. The people our repeat clients ask for by name. Detailed between every trip. Not at the end of the day. Bottled water on every ride. Locally owned. Owned and run in Scottsdale for twenty-plus years. Licensed. A permitted, licensed commercial operator, not a marketplace. Insured. Commercial coverage on every vehicle in the fleet.
